senses.meaning: Đầu; lãnh đạo, người đứng đầu; phần đầu của vật gì
examples: She nodded her head in agreement.
He hit his head on the low doorframe.
She is the head of the department.

note: Rất nhiều idioms: 'lose one's head' (mất bình tĩnh), 'head over heels' (say mê), 'off the top of my head' (nói mà không chuẩn bị).

senses.meaning: Cổ (phần nối đầu và vai)
examples: She wore a gold chain around her neck.
He craned his neck to see over the crowd.
The massage relieved the tension in her neck and shoulders.

note: 'Neck and neck' = ngang ngửa (trong cuộc đua). 'Breathe down someone's neck' = theo dõi sát sao.

senses.meaning: Vai; phần vai của quần áo; vai đường (lề đường)
examples: She tapped him on the shoulder to get his attention.
He carried the bag over his shoulder.
The hard shoulder of the motorway is for emergencies only.

note: 'Shoulder the blame/responsibility' = gánh chịu trách nhiệm. 'Give someone the cold shoulder' = phớt lờ.

senses.meaning: Ngực, lồng ngực; hòm, rương
examples: He felt a sharp pain in his chest.
She pressed the book to her chest.
A treasure chest was found buried beneath the old house.

note: 'Get something off your chest' = thổ lộ điều bấy lâu nay ấp ủ.

senses.meaning: Lưng; phần sau của vật gì
examples: He lay flat on his back and stared at the ceiling.
She suffers from chronic back pain.
Write your name on the back of the card.

note: 'Stab someone in the back' = phản bội. 'Turn your back on' = quay lưng lại với.

senses.meaning: Bụng, khoang bụng (thuật ngữ y tế); đốt bụng côn trùng
examples: The patient complained of pain in the lower abdomen.
Abdominal exercises strengthen the core muscles.
The surgeon made an incision in the upper abdomen.

note: Formal/medical. Thông thường dùng 'stomach' hay 'belly'.

senses.meaning: Hông (khớp và vùng giữa eo và đùi)
examples: She stood with her hands on her hips.
He broke his hip in the fall.
Hip replacement surgery is common among the elderly.

senses.meaning: Cánh tay; cánh (ghế, kính...); vũ khí (arms = vũ khí)
examples: She broke her arm in the accident.
He held the child in his arms.
The arms race between the superpowers defined the Cold War.

note: 'Arms' (số nhiều) = vũ khí. 'Up in arms' = phẫn nộ, bức xúc.

senses.meaning: Khuỷu tay; khúc cua góc nhọn
examples: She leaned on her elbow, staring out the window.
She nudged him with her elbow to get his attention.
There was a sharp elbow in the pipe.

note: 'Elbow room' = không gian để xoay sở. 'Elbow someone out' = chen chân đẩy ai ra.

senses.meaning: Cổ tay (khớp nối bàn tay và cẳng tay)
examples: She wore a bracelet on her wrist.
He checked his pulse at the wrist.
The handcuffs were clamped tight around his wrists.

note: 'A slap on the wrist' = phạt nhẹ, khiển trách nhẹ.

senses.meaning: Lòng bàn tay; cây dừa/cọ
examples: She held the small coin in the palm of her hand.
His palms were sweating with nervousness before the interview.
Rows of tall palm trees line the boulevard.

note: 'Palm off' = bán/tặng hàng kém chất lượng. 'Read someone's palm' = xem bói qua chỉ tay.

senses.meaning: Ngón tay
examples: She pointed her finger at the location on the map.
He cut his finger while chopping vegetables.
The ring slipped off her finger.

note: 'Put your finger on it' = xác định được vấn đề. 'Cross one's fingers' = cầu may.

senses.meaning: Ngón cái
examples: She gave a thumbs-up sign to show approval.
He accidentally hit his thumb with the hammer.
The baby sucked her thumb contentedly.

note: 'Under someone's thumb' = bị ai kiểm soát. 'Rule of thumb' = nguyên tắc cơ bản từ thực tế.

senses.meaning: Chân; chân bàn/ghế; chặng (hành trình)
examples: He broke his leg playing football.
She crossed her legs and leaned back in her chair.
The first leg of the journey takes four hours.

note: 'Leg up' = sự giúp đỡ để tiến lên. 'Pull someone's leg' = trêu chọc, đùa giỡn.

senses.meaning: Đùi (phần chân từ hông đến đầu gối)
examples: He felt a sharp pain in his thigh after the sprint.
The thigh muscles are some of the strongest in the body.
She slapped her thigh and laughed out loud.

senses.meaning: Đầu gối
examples: He fell and scraped his knee on the pavement.
She got down on her knees to pray.
Knee surgery kept him off the field for three months.

note: 'Weak in the knees' = bủn rủn chân. 'Bring someone to their knees' = khuất phục ai.

senses.meaning: Cổ chân (khớp nối bàn chân và cẳng chân)
examples: She twisted her ankle while running on the uneven path.
The water came up to his ankles.
An ankle brace helped support the injured joint.

senses.meaning: Gót chân; gót giày
examples: She wore shoes with high heels.
He felt a blister forming on his heel after the long walk.
The dog followed close at his heels.

note: 'Achilles' heel' = điểm yếu chết người. 'Head over heels' = say đắm hoàn toàn.

senses.meaning: Ngón chân; mũi giày
examples: She stubbed her toe on the furniture.
He stood on his toes to reach the top shelf.
The big toe is essential for balance when walking.

note: 'On your toes' = tỉnh táo, cảnh giác. 'Toe the line' = tuân thủ quy tắc.

senses.meaning: Trán
examples: She wiped the sweat from her forehead.
He kissed her gently on the forehead.
A deep crease formed on his forehead as he frowned.

senses.meaning: Lông mày
examples: She raised an eyebrow in surprise.
He had thick, dark eyebrows.
The controversial decision raised a few eyebrows at the meeting.

note: 'Raise an eyebrow' = tỏ ra ngạc nhiên hoặc nghi ngờ.

senses.meaning: Mí mắt
examples: He could barely keep his eyelids open after the long journey.
She applied eyeshadow to her eyelids.
A slight twitch in his eyelid betrayed his nerves.

note: 'Not bat an eyelid' = không tỏ ra ngạc nhiên hay bối rối.

senses.meaning: Lông mi
examples: She has long, dark eyelashes.
A piece of dust caught in her eyelash.
She batted her eyelashes playfully.

senses.meaning: Má; sự xấc láo, vô lễ (informal)
examples: Tears rolled down her cheeks.
He kissed her on both cheeks.
What a cheek — he didn't even say thank you!

note: 'Turn the other cheek' = tha thứ, không trả đũa. Nghĩa informal: sự xấc xược.

senses.meaning: Hàm (xương hàm trên/dưới)
examples: His jaw dropped in amazement.
She clenched her jaw in frustration.
The dentist examined his lower jaw.

note: 'Jaw-dropping' = đáng kinh ngạc.

senses.meaning: Cằm
examples: He rested his chin on his hand thoughtfully.
She has a small, pointed chin.
Keep your chin up — things will get better.

note: 'Chin up' = giữ vững tinh thần.

senses.meaning: Lỗ mũi
examples: A pungent smell assaulted her nostrils.
The horse's nostrils flared as it galloped.
He pressed one nostril closed and blew gently.

senses.meaning: Não; trí tuệ, tư duy
examples: The brain controls all bodily functions.
She has a brilliant brain for mathematics.
Brain injuries can have lasting effects on personality.

note: 'Brain drain' = chảy máu chất xám. 'Pick someone's brain' = khai thác kiến thức của ai.

senses.meaning: Tim; trung tâm; lòng can đảm, cảm xúc
examples: His heart was beating fast with excitement.
Heart disease is the leading cause of death worldwide.
She has a kind heart and always helps those in need.

note: 'Have a heart' = có lòng trắc ẩn. 'By heart' = thuộc lòng. 'Heart of the matter' = cốt lõi vấn đề.

senses.meaning: Phổi (cơ quan hô hấp)
examples: Smoking can seriously damage the lungs.
He took a deep breath and filled his lungs with the cold mountain air.
The doctor listened to her lungs with a stethoscope.

senses.meaning: Gan (cơ quan giải độc, tiêu hóa)
examples: Excessive drinking can permanently damage the liver.
The liver plays a key role in digestion and detoxification.
He was diagnosed with liver disease.

senses.meaning: Dạ dày; bụng (thông thường); khả năng chịu đựng
examples: I have a sharp pain in my stomach.
An empty stomach makes it hard to concentrate.
He couldn't stomach the sight of blood.

note: 'Stomach something' (v) = chịu đựng điều gì đó khó chịu. 'Turn someone's stomach' = gây buồn nôn.

senses.meaning: Thận (cơ quan lọc máu và tạo nước tiểu)
examples: The kidneys filter waste products from the blood.
He donated a kidney to save his brother's life.
Kidney stones can cause severe, debilitating pain.

senses.meaning: Ruột (small intestine = ruột non; large intestine = ruột già)
examples: Food passes from the stomach into the small intestine.
The large intestine absorbs water from digested food.
He had surgery to remove a section of his intestine.

senses.meaning: Bàng quang (cơ quan chứa nước tiểu)
examples: A full bladder can cause discomfort.
Bladder infections are more common in women than men.
He had to have his bladder removed due to cancer.

senses.meaning: Bộ xương; khung (cơ bản); 'skeleton staff' = nhân sự tối thiểu
examples: The human skeleton has 206 bones.
Only a skeleton staff remained over the Christmas holiday.
Archaeologists discovered a Bronze Age skeleton during the dig.

note: 'Skeleton in the cupboard' = bí mật xấu hổ trong quá khứ.

senses.meaning: Xương
examples: She broke a bone in her foot.
Calcium is essential for strong bones.
He has a bone to pick with you about last night.

note: 'Bone of contention' = nguồn gốc tranh cãi. 'To the bone' = đến tận cùng (chilled to the bone).

senses.meaning: Cơ bắp; sức mạnh, quyền lực
examples: He pulled a muscle while lifting heavy weights.
Regular exercise strengthens the muscles.
The union used its political muscle to block the legislation.

note: 'Muscle in on' = chen vào lấy phần.

senses.meaning: Khớp (xương); điểm nối; quán (informal)
examples: She has pain in her knee joint.
Arthritis causes inflammation of the joints.
They went to a burger joint after the film.

senses.meaning: Cột sống; gáy sách; gai (nhím, cây...); bản lĩnh
examples: Poor posture over time can damage the spine.
A chill ran down his spine when he heard the news.
The author's name appears on the spine of the book.

note: 'Backbone' và 'spine' đều dùng nghĩa bóng: can đảm, bản lĩnh.

senses.meaning: Xương sườn; sườn thịt (miếng thịt); gân (vải, lá)
examples: He cracked two ribs during the tackle.
The ribs form a protective cage around the heart and lungs.
She ordered a rack of ribs at the barbecue restaurant.

senses.meaning: Nắm đấm (tay nắm lại)
examples: He struck the table with his fist in frustration.
She raised her fist in victory.
He ruled the country with an iron fist.

note: 'Iron fist' = bàn tay sắt (cai trị hà khắc).

senses.meaning: Thuộc về tiêu hoá
examples: Exercise stimulates the digestive system.
Large meals overload the digestive process.
He suffered from a digestive disorder that required special diet.

senses.meaning: Da đầu; (nghĩa bóng) chiến lợi phẩm, thắng lợi trước đối thủ mạnh
examples: She massaged her scalp with shampoo.
Dry weather can cause a flaky scalp.
The team claimed another big scalp, defeating the champions.

senses.meaning: Cổ họng, hầu họng
examples: She had a sore throat and couldn't speak above a whisper.
He cleared his throat before giving the speech.
The words stuck in her throat.

note: 'Jump down someone's throat' = phản ứng gay gắt với ai.

senses.meaning: Ruột, nội tạng (thường dùng số nhiều: entrails)
examples: The entrails of the animal were used to make traditional sausages.
In ancient times, priests read entrails to predict the future.
The battlefield scene was graphic — entrails were visible.

note: Thường dùng số nhiều 'entrails'. Có thể dùng theo nghĩa bóng: 'the entrails of the system' = cốt lõi bên trong.

senses.meaning: Vòng ngực; lòng (ẩn dụ, nơi che chở yêu thương)
examples: She held the child close to her bosom.
He kept the secret within the bosom of his family.
She returned to the bosom of the church after years of doubt.

note: 'Bosom friend' = bạn tri kỷ. Formal/literary; thông thường dùng 'chest' hoặc 'breast'.

senses.meaning: Ruột già, đường tiêu hóa; (nghĩa bóng) nơi sâu nhất bên trong
examples: Bowel cancer is one of the most common cancers in the UK.
A healthy diet promotes good bowel function.
In the bowels of the earth, temperatures soar.

senses.meaning: Khuôn mặt, nét mặt (formal/literary); sự tán đồng
examples: She maintained a calm countenance despite her fear.
His countenance fell when he heard the news.
The management gave their countenance to the proposal.

senses.meaning: Ủng hộ, tán đồng (formal)
examples: I will not countenance such behaviour in my classroom.
The government refused to countenance any compromise.
She could not countenance the idea of leaving.

note: Formal/literary. 'Give countenance to' = thừa nhận, tán đồng.

senses.meaning: Nách; (informal) nơi tệ hại, tệ xã hội
examples: He tucked the newspaper under his armpit.
Deodorant is applied to the armpits.
This small town has been called the armpit of the state.

senses.meaning: Lòng (khi ngồi); vòng đua; phần nhô ra chồng lên
examples: The cat curled up in her lap.
He completed ten laps of the pool.
A chance like this lands in your lap only once.

note: 'Drop in someone's lap' = tình cờ mang lại cho ai. 'Lap of luxury' = cuộc sống xa hoa.

senses.meaning: Lỗ chân lông
examples: She used a cleanser to unclog her pores.
Every pore of his skin felt aware in the cold air.
Sweat escapes the body through the pores.

note: 'Pore over' (v) = nghiên cứu kỹ, đọc chăm chú (khác chính tả nhưng cùng phát âm).

senses.meaning: Sứ giả, người đại diện (được cử đi thực hiện nhiệm vụ ngoại giao hoặc bí mật)
examples: The president sent a personal emissary to negotiate the peace deal.
An emissary was dispatched to apprise the regent of the arrangement.
The emissary carried a sealed message from the king.
